tools.name: lookup_troubleshooting
tools.description: Call this tool whenever a customer reports a product problem. First identify the product, then pass the complete customer problem. Use only the returned troubleshooting steps. If matched is true and hasVideo is true, immediately call send_troubleshooting_video using the exact returned product and entryId.

tools.name: send_troubleshooting_video
tools.description: Call this tool only after lookup_troubleshooting returns matched true and hasVideo true. Pass the exact product and entryId returned by lookup_troubleshooting.IF ANYONE  TELL ISSUE IF THERE IS TROUBLESHOOTING VIDEO THAN SEND ISSUE LINK.

tools.name: send_customer_link
tools.description: Call this tool whenever the customer requests an approved Akiara link. Use callerNumber as customerPhone. Select the correct linkType based on the customer’s request. Confirm delivery only when the response returns success true and sent true.
